title: Qubits Asia 2026 Shows Impact of Quantum Computing Across Asia Pacific
summary: Qubits Asia 2026 showcased real-world quantum applications for telecom, manufacturing, healthcare, and logistics from D-Wave customers across Asia Pacific.
body_markdown:
D-Wave recently hosted


Qubits Asia 2026: Quantum Realized


, our quantum computing user conference, in Seoul, South Korea. The conference brought together


D-Wave executives, customers, researchers and industry experts to explore advances in quantum computing, share applications addressing real-world challenges, and discuss opportunities to drive quantum computing commercialization across Asia Pacific.


This year’s event featured hybrid-quantum applications and research spanning network optimization, manufacturing inspection, drug discovery, generative AI, semiconductor manufacturing and port operations, demonstrating the growing range of problems being tackled by today’s quantum computing.


Here’s a closer look at the applications and technology advances discussed in Seoul.
